"""Tokenizer for plain English text.

Words are maximal runs of letters, digits or apostrophes. Everything is lowercased. A word made of
apostrophes only is not a word. Examples:
    tokenize("Don't stop, DON'T!") -> ["don't", "stop", "don't"]
    tokenize("R2-D2 v2.0") -> ["r2", "d2", "v2", "0"]
"""
import re

WORD = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z']+")


def tokenize(text):
    return [w.lower() for w in WORD.findall(text) if len(w) > 0 and not (w.strip("'") == "'")]

to 2 decimals. An empty text gives "words=0 unique=0 avg_len=0.00".
"""
from .tokenize import tokenize


def summary(text):
    words = tokenize(text)
    unique = len(words)
    avg = sum(len(w) for w in words) / len(words)
    return f"words={len(words)} unique={unique} avg_len={avg:.2f}"
